title: 第19章 诡卫诡市双令第20章 被人堵门
slug: 青铜古舟第802章你惹上事了
content_zh:
沈算的视线投向院中角落。
那里还堆积着一部分未被消耗的“杀伐之器”
——破损的武器。
他刚想召唤吞噬之锁来吞噬，为诡街点灯，却见造化祭鼎仿佛拥有自己的“胃口”
和意志！
“嗡”
鼎盖轻颤，再次无声开启一线，一股无形的强大吸力骤然爆发！
墙角剩余的成捆铁器，如同被磁石吸引的铁屑，毫无反抗之力地再次腾空而起，排着队，争先恐后地投入那深不见底的鼎口！
仅仅几个呼吸之间，院角已被彻底清扫一空！
“嗯？”
沈算微怔，随即，脑海中自然而然地浮现出两个清晰的选择信息：
1.炼制【虚空传送令】：供诡卫穿梭使用。
2.修复【青铜古灯笼】：强化核心区域的照明与防御。
“炼制五枚虚空传送令！
剩余铁器，全力修复青铜古灯笼！”
沈算稍作权衡，立刻下达了指令。
指令既出，异象再生！
“呼——！”
阴风凭空卷起！
灰暗的龙卷风再次于鼎上成形，疯狂搅动着心眸虚界的灰白之雾与稀薄黑气。

祭台表面，那幽冷的暗灰色火焰“噗”
地一声再次升腾！
与此同时，沈算心中也升起一股明悟：虚无之力与诡异之力是点燃这造化之火的“薪柴”
，而杀伐铁器则是“材料”
以此法炼制与修复，不仅用料更省，更能最大程度地激发和恢复青铜古灯本身蕴含的玄奥威能！
明悟刚生，异变陡起！
悬挂在院门与诡街两侧的八十盏青铜古灯笼，仿佛被无形的力量唤醒！
它们齐齐脱离悬挂之处，化作一道道拖着昏黄烛火的流光，宛如群蛇归巢，主动投入那灰暗的龙卷之中，最终尽数没入造化祭鼎！
至此整个心眸虚界，除了祭台上那幽幽燃烧的暗灰色火焰，瞬间陷入了绝对的黑暗。
好在青铜古灯笼的重新祭炼，并未持续太久。
“咻！
content_en:
Shen Suan cast his gaze towards the corner of the courtyard.
There are still some unconsumed "killing weapons" piled up there.
-Broken weapons.
He was just about to summon the Devouring Lock to devour him and light up the strange street, but he saw that the Creation Sacrifice Cauldron seemed to have its own "appetite"
And will!
"Buzz"
The lid of the tripod trembled slightly, and the line was silently opened again, and an invisible and powerful suction force suddenly broke out!
The remaining bundles of iron in the corner, like iron filings attracted by a magnet, rose into the air again without resistance, lined up, and rushed to plunge into the bottomless mouth of the cauldron!
In just a few breaths, the corner of the courtyard has been completely cleaned!
"Huh?"
Shen Suan was startled for a moment, and then two clear choices naturally emerged in his mind:
1. Refining [Void Teleportation Order]: used for the shuttle guards.
2. Repair [Ancient Bronze Lantern]: Strengthen the lighting and defense of the core area.
"Refining five Void Teleportation Tokens!
The remaining ironware is used to restore the ancient bronze lantern! "
Shen Suan weighed it for a moment and immediately issued the order.
As soon as the order was given, the vision reappeared!
"Huh-!"
The dark wind blew up out of thin air!
The gray tornado formed on the tripod again, crazily stirring the gray fog and thin black air in the virtual world of the heart.
On the surface of the altar, the cold dark gray flame "pop"
The sound of the ground rose again!
At the same time, Shen Suan also had a clear understanding in his heart: the power of nothingness and strange power are the "firewood" that ignites the fire of creation.
, and killing iron weapons are "materials"
Refining and repairing in this way not only saves on materials, but also maximizes the ability to stimulate and restore the mysterious power contained in the ancient bronze lamp itself!
As soon as enlightenment is born, sudden changes occur!
The eighty ancient bronze lanterns hanging on both sides of the courtyard gate and the strange street seem to be awakened by invisible power!
They all escaped from the hanging place and turned into streams of light trailing the dim candlelight, like a group of snakes returning to their nests, actively throwing themselves into the dark tornado, and finally they were all submerged into the creation sacrificial cauldron!
At this point, the entire Heart Eye Realm, except for the faintly burning dark gray flames on the altar, instantly fell into absolute darkness.
Fortunately, the re-sacrifice of the ancient bronze lantern did not last long.
